text:
Predicates:
BritishSitcom(x) ::: x is a British Sitcom series.
Star(x, y) ::: x stars y.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Pilot(x, y) ::: x piloted in y.
WorkingTitle(x, y) ::: x has working title y.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x is the script editor for y.

Premises:
BritishSitcom(badults) ∧ Star(badults, pappys) ∧ Member(pappysMembers, pappys) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series, starring members of Pappy's.
Pilot(badults, july2013) ∧ Pilot(badults, bbcThree) ::: Badults piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
WorkingTitle(badults, theSecretDudeSociety) ::: The Working title "The Secret Dude Society" was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.

Conclusion:
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, series) ∧ WorkingTitle(series, theSecretDudeSociety) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for a series with the working title "The Secret Dude Society".
